A7_IS_NOT_COSMETIC.cause: `createPlanActions` calls `adapter.executeTool({ name, arguments })` with NO agent. But the tool it calls resolves its context from that exec: `where(exec)` = `{ workspace: dsh.workspaceRoot(exec), sessionId: sessionIdOf(exec) }`. So the missing agent is not a missing assertion field — WITHOUT IT THE TOOL CANNOT FIND THE RIGHT WORKSPACE OR SESSION.
A7_IS_NOT_COSMETIC.the_gap: `PlanActions.approve` takes `{ teamId, confirmation, captainSessionId }` — a shape built for the RETIRED tool, which took a team id. It carries neither an agent nor the plan id, and the executor holding it has no agent context of its own.
